summary: PDS Biotechnology filed an 8-K disclosing board changes tied to a September 7, 2026 securities purchase agreement: on September 12, the board expanded from six to eight directors, and at the September 14 initial closing, Nant Capital designees Dr. Patrick Soon-Shiong and Mr. James Banaag were appointed. Nant earns two board seats while holding 15% or more of common stock. Separately, PDS redeemed its Yorkville promissory note in full for roughly $4.6 million, terminating the $6 million 10% note due June 2027 with no penalty. Watch for further Nant governance influence and financing overhang.
